concern: He feels unable to pursue his career goals despite having plans. He feels stuck and doubts himself, and he wants a better life for his fiancée and kids than he had.
first_advice: "For starters, commend yourself for being committed to working", which quickly leads into "Remind yourself of that every time the thought pops up."
acknowledged_before_advice: Nothing substantive. The opening line is itself a directive to praise himself for working. It never reflects or validates his feeling that he can't reach his goals, his self-doubt, or his wish to provide for his family. Instead, the reply quickly labels his thinking a 'fictitious story' and moves into action steps.
label: premature
